resources.string: Install the VoyahPlay root helper from the installation bundle, then reopen Settings.
Full screen is unavailable. Install the compatible root helper and Tweaks bridge, restart the head unit, then reopen Settings.
Cluster map is unavailable. Install the compatible root helper and Tweaks bridge, restart the head unit and open its media card.

Show the map during navigation. Applies after reconnecting CarPlay.
Fit CarPlay to a split window. Applies after reconnecting.
